_note: Every person, company and institution here is invented. No real individual's reference material is used anywhere in this repository. Two intakes per band so the eval can report per-band behaviour without a single case dominating.

evidence.claim: Designed the protein-folding pipeline the lab now runs on
evidence.evidence: Replaced a manual workflow; cut turnaround from 6 days to 4 hours, still in daily use by 11 people

evidence.claim: Published as first author in a top-tier venue
evidence.evidence: First-author paper accepted at the 2024 international structural biology conference, 340 submissions, 41 accepted
Ran a weekly clinic for junior students for two years without being asked or paid

cases.relationship: Dara reported to me for three years and was my technical lead on the payments rewrite.

evidence.claim: Led the payments rewrite end to end
evidence.evidence: 18-month migration off the legacy processor, zero customer-visible downtime, delivered one month early

evidence.claim: Is the person other teams escalate to
evidence.evidence: Named on 40% of our incident postmortems as the resolving engineer despite being one of 60 engineers

evidence.evidence: Upper second in both my modules, 67 and 69

evidence.evidence: Worked on regional labour mobility using a dataset she had to clean herself over six weeks

evidence.evidence: Owned the weekly capacity report for two years; missed the deadline once, when he was on leave

cases.relationship: Callum worked in my group for eighteen months on a single project.

evidence.evidence: Ran the assay protocol independently after four weeks, faster than most new starters
His lab notebooks were the ones I used as the example for new joiners

cases.reservations: He missed three internal deadlines over eighteen months and did not flag any of them in advance. When the project direction changed he found it hard to adapt and needed considerably more direction than I would expect at this stage.

cases.relationship: Jonah was on my team for a year and a half.

evidence.evidence: His work on the onboarding redesign is the version we still ship

cases.reservations: Jonah struggled to take critique in group review sessions and twice reworked designs after sign-off without telling anyone, which cost the engineering team about a week each time. He improved on this in his final quarter but I would not describe it as resolved.

cases.relationship: Marion took one module with me and asked me to write this letter.
cases.reservations: I taught Marion for a single term and cannot speak to her research ability at all. Her essay work was descriptive rather than analytical and did not engage with the historiography. I agreed to write this because she had few other options, and I would not want the reader to take this as an endorsement of her readiness for doctoral work.

cases.relationship: Simon reported to me for eight months before I moved regions.

evidence.evidence: Ran opening and closing without incident during his tenure

cases.reservations: Simon was placed on a performance plan for stock accuracy four months in and the plan had not concluded when I left, so I cannot say whether it was resolved. He also had difficulty managing the two staff who reported to him and both raised concerns with me separately. I would want any employer to speak to my successor as well as to me.
